title: OpenImpala: Scalable Transport Property Computation on 3D Voxel Images of Porous Media
description: Open-source C++17 (AMReX + HYPRE, MPI/OpenMP/CUDA) and Python framework for computing steady-state tortuosity, symmetric 3x3 effective diffusivity tensors, multi-phase composite transport, and stereological microstructure metrics directly on 3D voxel images of porous media.

creators.name: Le Houx, James
creators.affiliation: University of Greenwich; ISIS Neutron and Muon Source, Rutherford Appleton Laboratory; The Faraday Institution
